resources.audit_note: Official homepage, 2027 call, alumni collection and terms inspected. Public program documentation and participant profiles are not independent evidence of business outcomes. The 2027 round requires both owner residence and business address within Providence, qualifying household income, and an established enterprise of five or fewer employees including owners and interns. Reimbursement is not advance funding; the program warns that businesses may carry up to USD 5,000 of costs for up to ten weeks, depending on their award. This is not a stated universal grant amount. No application submitted or personal tax information accessed. Website retains copyright; no blanket reuse license established. The October 13 information session has passed and was not added as upcoming.

resources.name: Textile Futures 2040
resources.description: Forum for the Future and H&M Foundation scenario project exploring alternative textile-industry conditions in 2040. Publishes four scenarios, a methods overview, comparative variables, fictional personas and artifacts, plus report downloads and a form-accessed workshop toolkit. Uses desk research, interviews, regional focus groups and scenario workshops to examine assumptions about production, power, work and environmental change. Scenarios are possibilities for discussion, not predictions or preferred outcomes.

benchmarks.application: Compare eligibility and mentorship with actual access to money. Reimbursement requirements may create a cash-flow barrier even where a program targets low-income applicants. Treat this as a question to investigate, not a measured outcome of this program. Preserve cohort records separately from testimonials and evaluated business results.

Use named practitioner cases to locate original museum programs and evaluations. Distinguish participation, reported experience and measured health outcomes; the conference announcement alone does not validate effectiveness.

Consider film, discussion, walks and exhibitions as complementary ways of examining the built environment. A film is an authored representation, not neutral proof, and requires its own provenance and rights context.

Keep evidence, uncertainties, constructed scenarios and fictional artifacts visibly separate. Compare how decisions perform across several possible conditions rather than promoting one desired future as inevitable. Sponsorship and participant-selection limitations should remain visible.

rights_and_access: Only independently written descriptions, metadata and original links are added. No third-party reports, photographs, films, teaching files, personal records or application data are reproduced. Public reading and paid participation do not imply an open reuse license. No forms, registrations, payments or mailing-list subscriptions were submitted.
verification_limits: Review covers the cited primary pages and published terms, not full report files, every underlying study, completed application transactions or independently evaluated program outcomes. The live Reservoir homepage and calendar were inaccessible through the web tool. Complete repository HTML templates were read and will remain unchanged; browser rendering has not been independently checked.
